Package com.rockchip.uhf.sdk

Class UhfSdk

java.lang.Object
com.rockchip.uhf.sdk.UhfSdk
public final class UhfSdk extends Object
SDK-01: the entry point third-party apps build against, distributed as com.rockchip.uhf:uhf-sdk (SDK-01's com.<oem>.uhf:uhf-sdk with the OEM this SRS was written for). UhfManager/UhfSession are @SystemApi, unreachable from a normal Gradle build without the platform source; this module's own build depends on the stub jar generated from the platform's API signature files instead (SDK-02) — see this module's README for how that stub is produced and its one known gap.

    • open

      public static UhfSdkSession open(android.content.Context context) throws android.hardware.uhf.UhfException
      Opens a session against the real reader. Callers should check isSupported(android.content.Context) first; this throws UhfException with UhfException.ERROR_DEVICE_LOST rather than returning null on a device with no reader, so a caller that skips the check still fails in one obvious place instead of getting a NullPointerException three calls later.
      Throws:
      android.hardware.uhf.UhfException

    • openFake

      public static UhfSdkSession openFake()
      SDK-09: an offline session backed by FakeUhfSdkSession — no reader, no @SystemApi access, no device required. For building and testing app logic without hardware; every write actually mutates the fake's in-memory tag store, so a write-then-read-back flow exercises the same code path an app would run against a real tag.
